::: notes

Allow about 5 minutes for the Short and the next two slides together. Read the question, then tap Play. The Short runs for 1 minute 38 seconds. It uses a thought experiment with one person starting at the Planck scale and a friend starting at the scale of the observable universe. Each second, one size grows by a factor of 10 and the other shrinks by a factor of 10. Take a few observations before moving to the brief continuation summary and then the table.

The Short remains the in-class video. “Watch later” opens the full episode at 3:40 (220 seconds) for students who want to watch afterwards; it is not an additional in-class viewing task. The next slide summarises the later milestones supplied by the teacher.

The player requires internet access. Use “Open the Short on YouTube” if the embedded player is unavailable, then return to the lesson. If the video cannot be played, describe the thought experiment and the two changes per second before continuing. Playback starts only when requested. Leaving this slide unloads the player.
